name: Nijioka Lili
source: A member of [url=/c28462]Alice's[/url] student council and the first member of the idol duo "Shiny". She acts kind and smiles a lot when working, but in reality is a sour and antisocial girl who pushes everyone away from her, expect for Hinata, her best friend and idol companion.
